answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the whisper of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The dawn of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
